definitions.lifecycle: Architectural census role only; it does not imply runtime reachability or capability.
definitions.canonical_domain: The single target subsystem that owns the organ in the canonical architecture.
definitions.built: Whether the in-scope source directory exists, with filesystem refs.
definitions.wiring: Attested runtime reachability; unknown is retained until direct call-path evidence is cited.
definitions.authority: Attested decision authority; none means this registry grants and infers no authority.
definitions.evidence: Strongest completed evidence stage and the repository refs supporting that stage.
